commentary_segments.text_raw:
Mismatch is determined
mainly by size and a number
of other design rules, which
are now discussed.
It is already known that
matching improves with the
square root of the size. This
is the main criterion. It
always works. There are
many other layout condi-
tions however, which help in
the reduction of mismatch.
They all work to some
extent, even when proof is
not easy to find in the litera-
ture. They are summarized
in 10 rules, as shown next.
commentary_segments.text: Mismatch is determined mainly by size and a number of other design rules, which are now discussed. It is already known that matching improves with the square root of the size. This is the main criterion. It always works. There are many other layout conditions however, which help in the reduction of mismatch. They all work to some extent, even when proof is not easy to find in the literature. They are summarized in 10 rules, as shown next.
